scriptLines: admission_date = coalesce(toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy')),

discharge_date = iif(isNull(coalesce(toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'))) || isNull(coalesce(toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'))) || coalesce(toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy')) < coalesce(toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy')), toDate(null()), coalesce(toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'))),

department = case(like(lower(trim(department)), '%onco%'), 'Oncology', like(lower(trim(department)), '%cardio%'), 'Cardiology', like(lower(trim(department)), '%emerg%') || lower(trim(department)) == 'er', 'Emergency', like(lower(trim(department)), '%ped%') || like(lower(trim(department)), '%paed%'), 'Pediatrics', like(lower(trim(department)), '%surg%'), 'General Surgery', like(lower(trim(department)), '%neur%') || like(lower(trim(department)), '%nuer%'), 'Neurology', like(lower(trim(department)), '%ortho%'), 'Orthopedics', 'General Surgery')) ~> derivedColumn1
